Apex Technologies - Compensation and Benefits Policy
Document type: Internal Company Policy | Company: Apex Technologies | Version: 1.0
1. Salary Payment
Employees receive their salaries on the last working day of each month. Salary payments are processed

through the company's designated payroll system.
2. Annual Performance Bonus
Eligible employees may receive an annual performance bonus of up to 15% of their base salary, depending
on individual and company performance.
3. Retirement Benefits

3. Retirement Benefits
The company contributes 8% of an eligible employee's basic salary to the employee retirement fund each
month.
4. Health Benefits
Full-time employees become eligible for health insurance after completing three months of continuous

employment. The policy covers eligible medical expenses subject to the insurer's terms.
5. Professional Development
Employees may claim reimbursement of up to INR 25,000 per financial year for approved professional
courses and certifications.

Apex Technologies - Travel and Expense Reimbursement
 Policy
Document type: Internal Company Policy | Company: Apex Technologies | Version: 1.0
1. Business Travel
Employees may claim domestic business travel expenses up to INR 6,000 per day, subject to prior
manager approval.
2. Meal Reimbursement

manager approval.
2. Meal Reimbursement
The maximum reimbursable meal expense is INR 800 per employee per day.
3. Internet Reimbursement
Eligible remote employees may claim up to INR 1,200 per month for home internet expenses.
4. Local Transport

4. Local Transport
Approved local business transportation expenses must be submitted within 15 calendar days after the
expense date.
5. Documentation
All reimbursement claims must include original receipts or valid digital invoices.

Apex Technologies - IT and Information Security Policy
Document type: Internal Company Policy | Company: Apex Technologies | Version: 1.0
1. Account Security
Employees must use passwords containing at least 14 characters. Passwords must include uppercase

letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters.
2. Authentication
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all corporate email accounts, cloud services, and remote
access connections.
3. Device Management

access connections.
3. Device Management
Company laptops must use full-disk encryption. Employees must install security updates within 7 calendar
days of their release.
4. Data Classification
Confidential information may only be accessed by employees with explicit business authorization. Public

information does not require special access approval.
5. Incident Reporting
Employees must report suspected cybersecurity incidents to the IT security team within 30 minutes of
discovery.

Apex Technologies - Workplace and Attendance Policy
Document type: Internal Company Policy | Company: Apex Technologies | Version: 1.0
1. Working Hours
The standard work schedule is 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
2. Remote Work

2. Remote Work
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with written manager approval.
3. Probation
New employees complete a probation period of 4 months from their joining date.
4. Annual Leave
Eligible full-time employees receive 18 days of annual leave per calendar year.
5. Attendance

5. Attendance
Employees arriving more than 10 minutes after their scheduled start time must notify their reporting
manager.
